text: A boy runs, along the road ACD, with velocity $v_{1}$. He has to get to point B which is in the field, in minimum time. The speed of racer in the field is $v_{2}=\frac{v_{1}}{n}$ (where, $n>1$). If at a distance x from D, the the racer must turn off the road, then find x (Take $n=3$)
solution:
From Snell's Law at C 
 $\mu_{1}sin~\theta=\mu_{2}sin~\phi$ 
 $\Rightarrow\mu_{1}sin~90^{\circ}=\mu_{2}sin~\phi$ 
 $\Rightarrow sin~\phi=\frac{\mu_{1}}{\mu_{2}}=\frac{v_{2}}{v_{1}}=\frac{1}{n}\Rightarrow\frac{x}{\sqrt{l^{2}+x^{2}}}$ 
 $n^{2}x^{2}=l^{2}+x^{2}\Rightarrow x=\frac{i}{\sqrt{n^{2}-1}}=\frac{i}{\sqrt{8}}$ 
 $\Rightarrow N=08.00$
